name: BF-02 process fact register
source: BF-02 process fact register v1.1 (Claude Docs, 16 Oct 2026); machine copy for the Burden & Fuel Optimiser

grades.A: BF-02 trial or clean step change
grades.B: BF-02 regression or event study with a standard error

revision_log.change: STRATA 1.5: blast moisture from the Open-Meteo daily RH at Wardha (DATA-11 restated, DATA-16 added: top-gas H2 validation); moisture data term removed (GAS-19 retired); GAS-14, 20, 22, 23, 25, 26, ASM-18, DATA-04, 06, 15 re-estimated / restated on the STRATA 1.5 posterior and the Open-Meteo basis. MOD / VAL regenerated.

STRATA 1.4: production channel removed (GAS-16 retired) after the strict 2023-24 test; GAS-14, 19, 20, 22, 23 and ASM-18 re-estimated / restated on the STRATA 1.4 posterior; added GAS-25 (strict out-of-sample test on 413 days of 2023-24), GAS-26 (per-ore credit test, Measured gap), DATA-15 (2023-24 data set). MOD / VAL regenerated.

STRATA 1.3: network solves in the optimiser (no surrogate); RI / RDI from the laboratory report (GAS-21, DATA-13); ore and pellet RDI as shaft fines; two oversize materials (GAS-24); nut-coke term (GAS-23); blast moisture from the smoothed RH (DATA-11, no steps; GAS-19 re-estimated); PCI and nut-coke defaults from the regime (ASM-08); GAS-13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, ASM-18 updated; MOD / VAL regenerated. Also: ASM-20 (slag sale credit), DATA-14 (plant prices 23 Oct 2026, fuels from the cost sheet), slag price 457.85 Rs/t; sinter RI / RDI from the latest raw-material strength data.

STRATA 1.2 (rename of the gas-flow / shaft-efficiency model, formerly OMEGA): groups MOD (coke responses of Fixed-omega and STRATA-omega, generated by utils.burden_engine.model_facts) and VAL (out-of-sample burnt coke by blend family) added; GAS-13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, ASM-01, ASM-18 updated (RI set S8, production channel split, Investigate tier); GAS-21 (RI assumptions), GAS-22 (production against efficiency), DATA-12 (heat-loss coverage) added; statuses Modelled only and Neutral added.

OMEGA v1.1 after the out-of-sample test: GAS-14, GAS-15 replaced (per-group scales, AR(1) posterior on daily changes); GAS-17 retired (gas-capacity channel); GAS-19 (blast moisture), GAS-20 (out-of-sample test), FLOW-15, FLOW-16 (within-period resistance and stave heat load by material), DATA-11 (weather-record blast moisture) added; GAS-13, ASM-18, DATA-04, FLOW-02 notes updated.
Blend-dependent shaft efficiency (#262): GAS-13..18, ASM-18, ASM-19 added; GAS-06 and GAS-10 notes updated. No existing value changed.
Machine copy shipped with the Burden & Fuel Optimiser (#251). BAND-01: lower end implemented as a validity check, not an optimisation row (fact v1.1). No fact value changed.

Engine 2.0: RAFT from the plant workbook at the input blast moisture (DATA-03/04); BAND-01..03 enforced in code; webapp hand coefficients removed (COKE-17); COKE-14 no longer reports the ideal shaft. No fact value changed.
Register created: 17 COKE, 11 GAS, 14 FLOW, 10 DATA, 3 BAND and 13 ASM facts. Retired COKE-17 and DATA-10.

facts.statement: STRATA-omega: shaft efficiency from STRATA-Flow network solves (BF-02 gas-flow model), ring counter-current reduction of wustite in the thermal reserve zone
facts.basis: STRATA-Flow v0.4.1 (burden profile from the charging matrix, layered Ergun resistance with shaft fines from the RDI of sinter, pellet and lump ore, floating cohesive zone); six rings, eps-NTU with NTU = kappa k t_TRZ C_s / C_min; k = [ln(1-RI)/ln(1-RI_sinter)]^beta (11.25/d)^n with the laboratory RI (GAS-21) and the as-charged Sauter size, beta 0 and n 1 calibrated on the plant data; kappa fitted to the calibrated omega. Network solved in the optimiser: at the calibration (+ Jacobian, 16 solves, cached), one solve per SLP iterate, three per reported plan (no surrogate; STRATA 1.2 used a quadratic surrogate)
facts.literature: Rist & Meysson W-point shaft efficiency; counter-current exchanger analogy for gas-solid reduction
facts.note: STRATA 1.3. Physics responses at the reference (omega per 10 wet pt replacing sinter): pellet +0.0089, clo -0.0040, rom -0.0065, gomti -0.0054, oversize -0.0040. About 1.1 s per network solve; a fixed-production plan takes 5-10 s.

facts.statement: Plant-data scales on the model channels of shaft efficiency (STRATA 1.5)
facts.basis: AR(1) Bayesian posterior of the daily change of omega against its 14-day anchor on exact network channels (191 days, 2025-12-15 - 2026-10-07, Open-Meteo daily blast moisture, DATA-11), RI set T26: lam_pellet 1.42 +/- 0.45, lam_lump (Lloyds CLO, Geomin, NMDC ROM, Donimalai incl. its oversize return, Gomti, Lloyds fines oversize) 0.92 +/- 0.46, other operating channel (coke layers, fuels, oxygen, blast) 0.80 +/- 0.28; no production channel (GAS-16 retired), no moisture term (GAS-19 retired); priors N(1, 0.5^2); rho 0.68, sigma_e 0.0172.
facts.note: Re-estimated on 2023-24 alone (411 days, Open-Meteo basis, information only, GAS-25): lam_pellet 1.59 +/- 0.39, lam_lump 1.11 +/- 0.50, other operation 1.10 +/- 0.39: the pellet and lump scales are replicated within 1 sd. STRATA 1.4 (RH-scaled record) had 1.39 / 0.97 / other 0.83; STRATA 1.3 1.38 / 0.96 / production 0.59 / other 0.98.

facts.statement: Pellet +10 wet pt -> shaft efficiency (STRATA 1.3, reference operation)
facts.basis: GAS-13 x GAS-14: pellet replacing sinter +0.0123 +/- 0.0041 (physics +0.0089 x lam_pellet 1.38). Pellet RI 82.4 % (laboratory, Jun 2026) against sinter 68.7 %. The 1 Jun 2026 pellet start is no longer confounded by a moisture step (DATA-11).
facts.literature: Gas utilisation rises with pellet share (Indian pellets); supersedes the data-only estimate in GAS-06
facts.note: Coke response at the reference point: MOD-01 (pellet for sinter) and MOD-08 (pellet for Lloyds CLO). Pellet above 25 % of ferrous is in the Investigate tier (GAS-18).

facts.statement: Production +1 t/h -> shaft efficiency (TRZ residence; production channel of STRATA 1.2 and 1.3)
facts.basis: Network -0.0022 omega per t/h (day runs, TRZ residence) x plant-data scale 0.59 +/- 0.30 (STRATA 1.3, 2026 data). Re-estimated on 2023-24 data: scale -0.42 +/- 0.28 (sign reversed). Out-of-sample coke skill with / without the channel: 2026 expanding 0.128 / 0.139; 2026 split Dec-May -> Jun-Oct 0.061 / 0.147; split Jun-Oct -> Jan-May 0.134 / 0.114; strict 2023-24 0.094 / 0.133.
facts.literature: Shaft efficiency falls at high productivity (shorter residence)
facts.note: Retired 23 Oct 2026 (STRATA 1.4). The residence penalty of the network is not seen in the plant data: the coke error against the production change is -0.58 +/- 0.61 kg/tHM per t/h with the channel and -0.10 +/- 0.63 without (2026). The q_prod column stays in the STRATA-Learn evidence store for re-tests (production step trial, Q12). Production acts on coke through the balance (GAS-22).

facts.statement: Gas quantity -> shaft efficiency (capacity ratio R = O_max,TRZ / (Y_W n_Fe), moved by its carbon-gas part)
facts.basis: Model (GAS-13) at R 0.70, NTU about 3; solved inside the two-zone balance (rist.solve_2z omega_fn). R follows the carbon gas only: H2 reduces wustite several times faster than CO and the ring model has no gas-side rate, so H2 is not counted as extra capacity (the data show omega rising with blast moisture, +0.0035 +/- 0.0011 per g/Nm3). Amplifies coke responses by about 1.35 (dK/domega -342 against -254 kg/tHM at fixed omega): HMT +10 degC 0.94 -> 1.26, Si +0.1 % 2.0 -> 2.7 kg/tHM
facts.note: Retired 21 Oct 2026 (OMEGA v1.1): out of sample the gas-capacity channel added no skill and its data scale was negative (expanding fits -0.5 to +0.2; -2.4 +/- 0.8 against the observed change, driven by moisture and Si). R is held at the calibration (omega_model.json gas_capacity_channel false).

facts.statement: Certainty tiers of a plan (STRATA-omega): High, Medium, Low, Investigate
facts.basis: High: sigma(coke) <= 2 kg/tHM and blend classes and production inside the 1st-99th percentile of the 191 days BF-02 ran (Donimalai oversize return counted as ROM); Medium: sigma <= 5 and within 5 pt / 3 t/h of that range; Low otherwise; Investigate: pellet above 25 % of ferrous or sigma(coke) above 8 kg/tHM (beyond common practice; 20 % pellet is standard, BF-02 ran <= 15 %). The default filter and auto mode exclude Investigate plans.
facts.note: User decision 22 Oct 2026 (Investigate at 25 % pellet). Low and Investigate results show their critical assumptions (RI, size exponent, plant-data scales) with the coke effect of each.

facts.statement: Blast moisture -> shaft efficiency (data term; retired in STRATA 1.5)
facts.basis: With the day's Open-Meteo moisture in the balance (DATA-11) the AR(1) data term is +0.0000 +/- 0.0009 omega per g/Nm3 and lowers out-of-sample coke skill (0.089 with, 0.120 without; RMSE 6.10 against 5.99 kg/tHM): STRATA 1.5 has no moisture term. Moisture acts on coke through the balance only (COKE-06). On the RH-scaled record (STRATA 1.4) the term was +0.0016 +/- 0.0024; STRATA 1.2 had 0.0042 +/- 0.0004 on the psychrometric series with seasonal steps. Within months the 2026 burnt coke rises +1.28 +/- 0.56 kg/tHM per g/Nm3 of Open-Meteo moisture and the energy model +1.58 +/- 0.46 (both unresolved on the RH-scaled record).
facts.literature: Hydrogen from blast moisture reduces wustite faster than CO; plant practice +1 g/Nm3 -> coke +0.6 to +1 kg/tHM
facts.note: In 2023-24 (steam injection 0-2.9 t/h) the burnt coke did not respond to moisture (ambient -0.10 +/- 0.16, steam +0.15 +/- 0.23 kg/tHM per g/Nm3 within months) while the balance adds +0.41 (ambient) and +0.72 (steam); the retired data term had compensated for this on the smoothed series. BF-02 does not inject steam in 2026.

facts.statement: Out-of-sample test of the shaft-efficiency model on 2026 data (STRATA 1.5)
facts.basis: Day minus its 14-day anchor, 175 days 1 Jan - 7 Oct 2026; parameters from earlier days only (monthly refit). Skill = 1 - MSE/MSE(Fixed-omega) on the same moisture basis. STRATA 1.5 (Open-Meteo daily moisture): omega 0.144 (day); burnt coke 0.120 (day, RMSE 5.99 vs Fixed-omega 6.39 kg/tHM), 0.221 (7-day). Time splits (train Dec-May, test Jun-Oct; train Jun-Oct, test Jan-May): 0.095 / 0.111 (day). STRATA 1.4 on the RH-scaled record: 0.139 (RMSE 6.44 vs 6.94). The moisture basis alone lowers the Fixed-omega RMSE from 6.94 to 6.39. Per-ore credit test (GAS-26): joint p 0.45 (Fixed-omega 0.72). By blend family: VAL-01..12. Strict test on 2023-24 data: GAS-25.
facts.note: Alternatives on the same days (coke skill, day / 7-day / split Dec-May / split Jun-Oct; RMSE): STRATA 1.5 (final) 0.120 / 0.221 / 0.095 / 0.111; 5.99; with moisture term (STRATA 1.4 form) 0.089 / 0.200 / 0.096 / 0.114; 6.10; with production channel 0.102 / 0.210 / 0.021 / 0.134; 6.06; without nut-coke term 0.105 / 0.185 / 0.120 / 0.102; 6.05; with PCI term 0.098 / 0.232 / 0.043 / 0.095; 6.07

RAFT regression on DPR values: 2021 + 0.41 HBT + 27.2 enrichment - 2.02 PCI
facts.basis: R2 0.70; HBT and O2 coefficients 40-65 % of physical values (operators move levers together)
facts.note: Retired 16 Oct 2026; replaced by DATA-03

facts.statement: Blast moisture from the Open-Meteo daily relative humidity at Wardha
facts.basis: Daily mean RH (mean of 24 hourly values, Open-Meteo; shipped file 1 Jan 2023 - 15 Oct 2026, later days from the Open-Meteo forecast endpoint, cached), mapped linearly to the plant range 7-21 g/Nm3 (RH 26.1 -> 7, 86.2 -> 21; 1st / 99th percentile of the 31-day centred Open-Meteo RH); no smoothing. Day-to-day SD 1.21 g/Nm3 (RH-scaled record 0.18); 2026 mean 13.3 g/Nm3. June 2026: 13.0 against 19.0 g/Nm3 on the record (the monsoon reached Wardha late in June). Days without a value: Open-Meteo day-of-year mean (31-day centred), then the monthly table (DATA-04).
facts.next_test: Calibrate the RH mapping on the steam-referenced H2 response (DATA-16), or use temperature with the RH for the absolute humidity
facts.note: utils/coke_energy/weather.py; config coke_energy.blast_moisture.source open_meteo (default) | rh_scaled (31-day centred RH of the 2025-26 weather record, the STRATA 1.4 basis) | psychrometric | table. Effect on the models (2026): TRACE - FORGE SD per shift 7.82 -> 7.31 kg/tHM, Fixed-omega RMSE 6.94 -> 6.39, STRATA 6.44 -> 5.99. User decision 25 Oct 2026 (moisture study, option A).

facts.statement: Reducibility (RI) and reduction-degradation index (RDI) of the ferrous materials (set T26, Evonith laboratory) and the RI-to-rate link of STRATA-omega
facts.basis: Laboratory report (48 tests, 2015-2026; RI IS 8167:1989, RDI ISO 4696-1), values as given (user decision 23 Oct 2026): the test of the same source nearest the model period; composition of the tested sample against the period ore (Fe, SiO2, Al2O3) within normal supply variation; adjustment by the report's slopes below 0.4 pt RI / 0.9 pt RDI. RI: sinter 66.0, pellet 82.4, lloyds_clo 84.5, lloyds_oversize 83.9, geomin 79.2, nmdc_rom 60.6, donimalai 78.4, gomti 65.0 %. RDI: sinter 30.1, pellet 14.5, lloyds_clo 22.1, lloyds_oversize 22.6, geomin 6.8, nmdc_rom 27.8, donimalai 18.8 %. Gomti: no test (65 %). Link r = [ln(1-RI)/ln(1-RI_sinter)]^beta (11.25/d)^n calibrated on the plant data with these values: beta 0, n 1. Out-of-sample coke skill (day / 7-day): first-order link (beta 1, n 1.5) 0.023 / 0.092; calibrated 0.128 / 0.219; literature RI set S9 0.120 / 0.217.
facts.next_test: Sinter RI in the same laboratory (basis check); Gomti RI and RDI; repeat Lloyds CLO (tests 51-84 % since 2022) and Donimalai (single test)
facts.note: Sinter RI and RDI are taken from the latest raw-material strength data (routine test; calibration "sinter_strength"), not from the laboratory report (user decision 23 Oct 2026). The measured RI differences (NMDC ROM 61 to Lloyds CLO 84 %) show no effect on the plant omega: the skill rises as beta falls and is highest at beta = 0 (s13/ri_link_scan.py). Likely causes: the 180-min test at 900 degC on 10-12.5 mm pieces saturates for these ores while 15-25 mm lumps in the shaft are limited by gas diffusion; supply variation (Lloyds 51-84 %); the sinter routine RI may be on another basis. Within hematite / goethite CLOs RI does not follow LOI (0.9 +/- 1.0 per pt, R2 0.03); magnetite lowers it (-1.4 per pt FeO). Critical assumptions show the coke effect of beta 0 -> 0.25 and n 1.0 -> 1.5.

facts.statement: Production against efficiency: dilution of the fixed heat loss against shorter TRZ residence (BF-02 data)
facts.basis: Within-month regressions (200 days, HAC): heat loss GJ/h per t/h -0.59 +/- 0.63 (fixed per hour: dilution 7.4 MJ/tHM per t/h); omega -0.0011 +/- 0.0008 per t/h; burnt coke -1.33 +/- 0.44, charged coke -0.89 +/- 0.51 kg/tHM per t/h. Out-of-sample coke error against the production change (HAC, kg/tHM per t/h): 2026 Fixed-omega -0.30 +/- 0.69, STRATA 1.3 -0.58 +/- 0.61, STRATA 1.4 -0.10 +/- 0.63; 2023-24 Fixed-omega -1.15 +/- 0.40, STRATA 1.2 -1.65 +/- 0.40, STRATA 1.3 -1.39 +/- 0.39, STRATA 1.4 -1.08 +/- 0.40. STRATA 1.5 (Open-Meteo basis): 2026 Fixed-omega -0.35 +/- 0.58, STRATA 1.5 -0.12 +/- 0.52; 2023-24 Fixed-omega -1.26 +/- 0.38, STRATA 1.5 -1.07 +/- 0.37.
facts.literature: Higher productivity lowers fuel rate through heat-loss dilution until residence time limits gas use
facts.note: Dilution is confirmed. The residence penalty is not: with the production channel the error against the production change moves further from zero in both periods, so STRATA 1.4 has no production channel (GAS-16 retired). Net burnt coke falls with production in the record, partly through furnace condition (good days run faster): the coefficient is an upper bound on the benefit. In 2023-24 every model under-credits production by about 1 kg/tHM per t/h.

facts.statement: Nut coke +1 kg/tHM -> shaft efficiency (data term, STRATA 1.3+)
facts.basis: AR(1) posterior with GAS-14 (STRATA 1.5): +0.00100 +/- 0.00034 (3.0 se). The network carries nut coke as coke-layer mass only (-0.0002 omega per kg); the data show omega rising with nut coke in the ore layer (mixed-layer reduction, cohesive-zone permeability). Out of sample (2026): coke skill 0.120 with the term, 0.105 without (7-day 0.221 / 0.185). 2023-24 re-estimate 0.0003 +/- 0.0004 (not resolved; nut coke varied little).
facts.literature: Nut coke mixed into the ore layer raises reduction and gas permeability (Japanese and European practice)
facts.next_test: Nut-coke step trial (+15 kg/tHM for 7 days at constant blend)
facts.note: PCI: no data term. With it the skill falls (0.098); PCI acts through the balance (carbon, energy, H2) and the network (-0.00001 omega per kg). PCI and nut coke page defaults are the regime medians (ASM-08).

facts.statement: Per-ore coke credit test (day level): coke error against the share change of each ore class
facts.basis: Slope of the daily out-of-sample coke error (realised - predicted) on the day's change of each class against its 14-day window, HAC(5), per +10 wet pt; positive = the model gives the ore too much credit. 2026 (175 days, Open-Meteo basis): STRATA 1.5 pellet -2.6 +/- 3.5, CLO -2.8 +/- 2.9, ROM -4.2 +/- 2.9, Gomti -4.4 +/- 3.7, Lloyds fines oversize -3.0 +/- 2.7, joint p 0.45; Fixed-omega joint p 0.72. 2023-24 (411 days, frozen): STRATA 1.5 pellet +2.8 +/- 2.7, CLO +8.2 +/- 3.1, NMDC +12.1 +/- 3.9, joint p 0.010; Fixed-omega pellet -0.6 +/- 2.9, CLO +8.4 +/- 3.2, NMDC +13.2 +/- 4.0, joint p 0.001.

facts.note: The 2026 test passes for STRATA 1.5 and for Fixed-omega on the Open-Meteo basis (on the RH-scaled record Fixed-omega failed it, joint p 0.044). In 2023-24 both models over-credit CLO and NMDC replacing sinter; the cause is outside the shaft-efficiency model (unrecorded sinter quality is the leading candidate). A day-level ore credit is resolved to about +/- 4 kg/tHM per 10 pt.
